notes.title: New post-game content + Translations
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

When we first started Dice People, we never really expected the game to do as well as it's doing right now during the release. We're really happy to see people enjoying our game and requesting for more content!

Because of that, the game will gain post-game content soon. (New boss, more skills, and some other cool things).

Also, the game will gain translations to Japanese and Brazilian Portuguese, and maybe other languages too! 

Thanks for everyone that played, reached out to send feedback, made videos playing the game, and supported the game. That means a lot to us!

Thanks!

notes.title: Balance Update + QoL fixes + Skilltree update
notes.content:
This update fixes bugs, buffs and nerfs a few skills and also adds new upgrades to make the game progress more exciting.

[h2]New skills[/h2]

The "wall" mechanic was changed to other upgrades, to make progress in the skilltree more exciting, taking into consideration player feedback. A new skill that allows slimes to drop other items other than coins was also added

[h2]Balancament fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] XP gain is now easier in the late game
[*] Synergy debuff in the start
[*] Spawn adjusted to each prestige level
[/list]

[h2]QoL fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Shop description for each class
[*] Option to reset your save
[*] You can now restart the turn directly
[*] Lag fixes
[*] The game now launches in fullscreen
[*] Titles for each prestige level
[*] Overall UI fixes
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Rogue steal not working properly
[*] XP farm not working properly
[/list]
